description: This file defines helper functions for constructing Ditto Protocol messages, external messages, and conversions between ArrayBuffer and String, tailored for use with Eclipse Ditto and possibly bytebuffer.js library.

methods.name: buildDittoProtocolMsg(namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra)
methods.description: Constructs a Ditto Protocol message object with specified parameters including namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, headers, value, status, and extra info.

methods.name: buildExternalMsg(headers, textPayload, bytePayload, contentType)
methods.description: Creates an external message object with headers, optional text or byte payload, and content type.

methods.name: arrayBufferToString(arrayBuffer)
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer into a string by interpreting its contents as unsigned 8-bit integers.

methods.name: stringToArrayBuffer(string)
methods.description: Converts a string into an ArrayBuffer where each character is stored as an unsigned 8-bit integer.

methods.name: asByteBuffer(arrayBuffer)
methods.description: Transforms an ArrayBuffer into a ByteBuffer instance (from bytebuffer.js library), wrapping the buffer for further processing.

ctags.name: buildDittoProtocolMsg
ctags.pattern: /^  function buildDittoProtocolMsg(namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHe/
ctags.signature: (namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra)
